summary: Component I4 of the plan docs/plans/wave-integration-2026-10.md (decisions D7, D8 and D9, ADR-0147). The spec is docs/architecture/wave-orchestrator.md section 15. A batch flushes as one PR on the first trigger. The triggers are: the wave ends, the batch reaches its cap, its oldest deliverable reaches max_age_minutes, or a deliverable unblocks queued work. The cap starts at 4, stays between 1 and 4, halves on a confirmed red and grows by 1 on a green batch. The operator set the cap to 4 and max_age_minutes to 45 on 2026-10-27 (Q1).
